anchor_definition: The anchor is the phone-login submit handler (the useCallback bound to _): its body reads e.password/e.mobile, derives a nonce i=F.dnGetter(), computes s=G().ne(nonce+password, d()(mobile.slice(3)+nonce)) and posts {mobile, data:s, time:i}. PLAN §4.3: the encrypted data value is constructed inline here (no dedicated encrypt function), so this enclosing handler is the anchor; PLAN §5.1: not the imported cipher/hash helpers (G, d, F) or sibling login-component renders.

anchor.why: The memoized phone-login submit callback. Builds s = G().ne(nonce+password, key=d()(mobile.slice(3)+nonce)) and calls x.byPhoneNumber({mobile, data:s, time}). This constructs the exact encrypted data value sent in the login request.

roles.why: The LoginByGZH (WeChat official-account) component render in the same chunk; a sibling login method with no password encryption.
The LoginModal container render in the same chunk; UI scaffolding unrelated to password encryption.
